messages:
Asha Patel: Huge personal update — baby arrived this morning! Welcome to the world: Luca Raj Patel, 7 lb 4 oz, 20.5 inches. Mom and baby are doing great. I'll be on parental leave starting next Monday, ping Marco for anything urgent. Registry: https://example.com/asha-registry :heart: :baby:
Marco Chen: OMG congrats Asha!! :tada: That picture is perfect 😭
Priya Singh: So so happy for you!! When's your return date? we should throw a little send-off next week :confetti_ball:
Asha Patel: Thanks!! Tentatively back October 6 — will confirm once we settle into a rhythm. Love a send-off ❤️
Noah Brooks: Amazing news, huge congrats. Sending a card — where should we ship it?
Leah Kim: Congratulations!! Adding a card to the team giftpool. Anyone want to chip in for a meal train? I can coordinate.
Marco Chen: I can cover on-call the week you’re out. Also putting a note in the rota for PR reviews.
HR Bot: Congrats Asha! Reminder: parental leave process and benefits here: https://redwood.example/hr/parental-leave. Please file the leave request so payroll and coverage are set up. If you need help, DM People Ops.
Priya Singh: adding to calendar now. Also — cake in the kitchen Friday? :cake:
Asha Patel: You’re the best. No presents needed — your time and support is plenty. Cake would be adorable though :blush:
Noah Brooks: Sending love from the infra crew. If you want, I can tag you on any high-priority alerts and only escalate if necessary.
Leah Kim: Meal train signup: https://signup.example/asha-meals — pls add a slot if you can. If folks prefer to Venmo, DM me.
Marco Chen: Got it on coverage. Enjoy every minute, Asha. We'll keep things smooth here :muscle:
Asha Patel: Thank you all — feeling so lucky. I'll post a few more pics when we get home.
_meta: thread about baby arrival and parental leave — casual team congrats and coordination
